## Skill Discovery Rules

1. Global skills: `~/.config/opencode/skills/**/SKILL.md`
2. Project skills: `.opencode/skills/**/SKILL.md` (if exists)
3. Built-in skills: opencode internal skills
4. Skills are indexed by `trigger` field in frontmatter
5. Multiple skills can match; all applicable skills are loaded

## Usage

```bash
# Update registry after skill changes
/skill-registry

# Or invoke directly
skill registry
```
